# Generated by `cargo run -p agent_docs` from the diagnostic registry and compiler/tests/ui; do not edit.
title: "V4001 non_exhaustive_match"
description: "A match does not cover every value."
---

An error from the `pattern` phase. `sakura explain V4001` prints this explanation offline.

A `match` does not cover every value. The diagnostic names a witness value that no arm
matches. Guards never count toward coverage (design §4.10).

Wrong:

```sakura
match o { Some(n) if n >= 0 => n }
```

Fixed:

```sakura
match o { Some(n) if n >= 0 => n, _ => 0 }
```

## Wrong program

[`compiler/tests/ui/V4001_non_exhaustive_match.sak`](https://github.com/icantcodefyi/sakuralang/blob/master/compiler/tests/ui/V4001_non_exhaustive_match.sak), which the compiler's ui suite runs through `sakura check`:

```sakura
error ParseError(input: String)

fn parse_age(s: String) -> Int ! {Fail<ParseError>} {
  match String.parse_int(s) {
    Some(n) if n >= 0 => n,
    Some(_) => fail ParseError { input: s },
  }
}
```

## Fixed program

[`compiler/tests/ui/V4001_non_exhaustive_match.fixed.sak`](https://github.com/icantcodefyi/sakuralang/blob/master/compiler/tests/ui/V4001_non_exhaustive_match.fixed.sak), which `sakura check` accepts with no diagnostics:

```sakura
error ParseError(input: String)

fn parse_age(s: String) -> Int ! {Fail<ParseError>} {
  match String.parse_int(s) {
    Some(n) if n >= 0 => n,
    Some(_) => fail ParseError { input: s },
    None => fail ParseError { input: s },
  }
}
```
